title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper Input
description: Configure the LinkedIn jobs search parameters.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: List of job search keywords (e.g., 'Software Engineer', 'Data Scientist').

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of job listings to scrape.

scrapeJobDetails.title: Scrape Full Job Details
scrapeJobDetails.description: If enabled, scrapes full job description from each job page (slower but more data). If disabled, only scrapes listing data.

datePosted.title: Date Posted Filter
datePosted.description: Filter jobs by when they were posted.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests. Higher = faster but more likely to be blocked.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Use Apify residential proxies for best results.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional. Directly provide LinkedIn job search URLs to scrape instead of building from keywords. If provided, these take priority over searchQueries.
